description: This file defines the Reward model class for managing customer reward records in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods to add, delete, retrieve, and summarize reward points associated with customers and orders.
external_files: Database connection/constants (implied by usage of DB_PREFIX and $this->db)

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A model class responsible for handling customer reward points, including CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Creates a new reward record for a customer related to an order.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward records for a customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward records associated with a specific order, only those with negative points.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reward records for a customer with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward entries for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Returns the total sum of reward points for a customer.
